day_shape: 72 items: Trump paused US naval escorts in Hormuz citing 'great progress' on a one-page US-Iran memo, US tabled a UNSC draft threatening Iran sanctions, CENTCOM said 52 vessels turned back, IDF struck ~25 Hezbollah sites; nothing from UK Parliament.

threads.label: Trump pauses Hormuz escorts, talks advance
threads.summary: Trump announced a pause in US naval escort operations through the Strait of Hormuz, citing progress towards a deal with Iran, while Axios and Reuters reported the sides are closing in on a one-page memo to end the war. Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said Tehran's response had not yet been delivered, and South Korea suspended its review of joining the US escort operation.

threads.label: US UNSC resolution on Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio announced the US is proposing a UN Security Council resolution to defend freedom of navigation and secure the Strait of Hormuz, with sanctions threatened if Iran does not halt its threats to commercial shipping. Rubio also spoke with Russian FM Lavrov about Iran at Lavrov's request.

threads.label: CENTCOM posture and shipping incidents
threads.summary: CENTCOM said the USS George H.W. Bush and other warships are enforcing a US naval blockade of Iran, with 52 commercial vessels directed to turn back, and posted images of F-16 patrols and MH-60 helicopter operations near the Strait. The Jerusalem Post reported a French vessel was attacked transiting the Strait, wounding several crew, and Defense Secretary Hegseth said the Iran ceasefire was 'not over'.

threads.label: Iranian military messaging on Hormuz
threads.summary: Armed forces spokesman Shekarchi claimed the US 'Freedom of the Strait of Hormuz' project had failed and warned of 'shameful defeat' for any aggressor, while Iran's Naval Force said safe passage would resume under new Iranian procedures. Defa Press also published an analysis claiming Trump's withdrawal from the operation reflected operational failure.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah activity
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck approximately 25 Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and reported two soldiers wounded in a Hezbollah drone attack, while Defa Press claimed an Israeli strike on Zlaya in Baalbek killed and wounded nine. Syria's Interior Ministry said it dismantled a Hezbollah-linked cell plotting to assassinate officials, and Rubio said Hezbollah remained the obstacle to Israel-Lebanon peace.

threads.label: Khamenei office and wartime domestic messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted Workers' Day and Teachers' Day messages praising public street presence and framing the 'December coup of 1404' as a war imposed by America and the Zionists, while parliament speaker Qalibaf issued a second audio message warning of economic-pressure strategy. President Pezeshkian denounced profiteering, and Iran International reported tensions over hijab enforcement and women protesters held at Vakilabad prison.

threads.label: China drone supply and war reconstruction
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal, picked up by IRIB and Iran International, reported Chinese firms continue shipping motors, chips and fibre-optic cables used in Shahed drone production to Iran and Russia despite US sanctions. Iran's oil minister and National Iranian Gas Company CEO Tavakkoli announced reconstruction of four damaged South Pars refineries and other oil facilities, and UNHCR issued Emergency Update #16 on regional displacement from Iran and Lebanon hostilities.

An excerpt from the message of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Revolution: In the past year, our dear people experienced three military and security wars... The second war was the December coup, which America and the Zionist system, thinking that the Iranian people, as a result of imposed economic hardships, would realise the enemy's agenda, using their mercenaries, perpetrated countless atrocities and martyred a greater number of our dear compatriots compared to the previous war and caused extensive damages. 29 Esfand 1404. The Matured collection of texts returns to a reading of the messages and texts of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader
